_doc: GROWTH-1 (owner, 2026-11-12): the virtual product manager owns growth, not bug fixes. Targets are numbers the product must move; knobs are the places the system can change to move them; experiments are growth changes each with a prediction. foundation/growth.py files each proposed experiment as a queue item labelled `growth`, files repair items from clockwork misses, and fails the check when work filed is fixes only or the growth share of filed work falls under the floor. Reads doctrine/market.json (gaps become growth items), docs/issues, ops/improvements.jsonl. Consumers: foundation/growth.py, tests/foundation/test_growth.py, role product-manager.

targets.why: pilot applications are the conversion the front door exists for
an idea flow that people finish
the product is systems that ship code on their own

knobs.what: headline, hint and suggestions on the front door
fields and length of the pilot application

experiments.hypothesis: Fewer required fields raise the share of started applications that are sent.
Follow-up questions chosen from the first answer keep people in the interview.
Three concrete running systems on the front door raise taps into the interview.
A second tenant system with its own deploy loop proves the product beyond tenant 0.
